_comment: Tier-2 for fourc::particle_sph#2, and a falsification of its Signal. The DOMAINBOUNDINGBOX is left byte-identical to upstream particle_sph_1d_hydrostatic_freesurface_densityintegration_cubicspline_adami.4C.yaml; the only change is the direction and size of gravity, which flings the free-surface column out through the far x face instead of settling it. 4C does not abort: it silently deletes particles as they leave, 48 separate times, each with the same contentless line 'on processor 0 removed 1 particle(s) being outside the computational domain!' carrying no id, no position, no step and no phase. Because the baseline arm removes nothing on the same geometry, all 48 are mid-run — the 'throughout the simulation, including splashing' part a startup-only check would miss. The single PROC 0 ERROR block comes at the very end, 'expected 5 tests but performed 0'. There is no 'particle outside DOMAINBOUNDINGBOX' string. Verified by execution 2026-08-06 against 4C at /home/alexander/4C/build/4C.
expect_in_output: on processor 0 removed 1 particle(s) being outside the computational domain!

_mutation.note: remove the pathology: leave the deck's own settling gravity in the second arm. Nothing then leaves the box, the removal line never appears, the deck passes and EXIT_FLUNG becomes 0, so the fixture must go red.
